## Cold-start benchmark results — `dev.lincforge.benchtarget` on Pixel 8 Pro (<REDACTED-1>, Android 16)

Methodology: for each run, force-stopped the app (`am force-stop`, ensuring the process was fully dead), launched via `am start`, and read Android's own `ActivityTaskManager: Displayed ... +Xms` log line — the system-measured time from process start to first frame drawn (standard Android cold-start metric).

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|-----|----------------------|
| 1   | 280 |
| 2   | 230 |
| 3   | 232 |
| 4   | 226 |
| 5   | 228 |

**Median:** 230 ms
**Mean:** 239.2 ms
**Standard deviation (sample, n−1):** ≈ 22.9 ms (variance ≈ 525.2 ms²)
**Standard deviation (population):** ≈ 20.5 ms (variance ≈ 420.2 ms²)

Run 1 was the outlier (280 ms vs. 226–232 ms for the rest) — likely first-run filesystem/binder cache effects even though the process itself was cold each time; runs 2–5 were tightly clustered.
